# Library fixtures

Three icons copied byte-for-byte from the pinned libraries, so the gated suite exercises real library
markup without a network or a cache. The libraries themselves are never vendored — `scripts/toolchain.sh`
fetches them.

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `simple-icons-facebook.svg` | simple-icons 16.31.0, `icons/facebook.svg` | CC0-1.0 (data). The mark is a trademark of its owner — follow its brand guidelines. |
| `material-alarm.svg` | `@material-symbols/svg-400` 0.47.3, `outlined/alarm.svg` | Apache-2.0, Copyright Google LLC |
| `material-error-fill.svg` | `@material-symbols/svg-400` 0.47.3, `outlined/error-fill.svg` | Apache-2.0, Copyright Google LLC |
